title: spergula madoniaca
intro: Spergula madoniaca, commonly known as Corn Spurry, is a type of annual herbaceous plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spergula madoniaca include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
